rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single image, but it likely overstates expansion/fullness and TE cohesion from this frame; image shows a visible ICM and blastocoel but morphology is somewhat less crisp than described.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior outcomes, male factor context, endometrium, BMI, and embryo stage/grade into prognosis and counseling.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor overconfidence in image-based morphology.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET, luteal support, and caution against unproven add-ons; minor speculative points about fresh antagonist-cycle receptivity are appropriately framed.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management, lifestyle counseling, and structured future evaluation if unsuccessful, with appropriate nuance.
